rules.statement: The IP does not include an elaboration check for illegal parameter values (REQ-PARAM-001).
$clog2 may be used for the derived widths.
PARA_SFIFO_DEPTH (default 8) must be an integer of 2 or more with no upper limit; it sets the number of entries, storage size and pointer width.
PARA_SFIFO_DATA_W (default 32) must be 1 or more with no upper limit and sets the width of i_wr_data, o_rd_data and the storage.
PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME (default 0) must be 0 or 1: 0 = direct pointer path, 1 = one retiming flop in the destination domain.
PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME changes only flag latency and crossing path timing; the FIFO function is the same for both values.
PARA_SFIFO_MEM_USE_MACRO (default 0) must be 0 or 1: 0 = RTL array storage, 1 = library SRAM wrapper storage.

rules.condition: when PARA_SFIFO_MEM_USE_MACRO is 1 until the real macro is mapped
rules.statement: The SRAM wrapper must use the macro model VLSIT_CELL_SRAM_1W1R of 000_Common.
LPARA_ADDR_W must be derived as clog2(PARA_SFIFO_DEPTH), at least 1, and sets the memory address width.
LPARA_PTR_W must be derived as clog2(2 x PARA_SFIFO_DEPTH), at least 2; the pointer counts 0 to 2 x DEPTH - 1.
LPARA_OCC_W must be derived as clog2(PARA_SFIFO_DEPTH + 1), at least 2, and sets the width of i_full_thr and i_empty_thr; occupancy is 0 to DEPTH.
The smallest legal instance must elaborate and lint with the same hierarchy.

rules.condition: depth below 2, data width 0, or option parameter outside 0..1
rules.statement: These illegal configurations must not be used; the IP does not check them and its behavior with them is not specified.
The depth is legal but gap-free streaming is not guaranteed.
